Frontend loads correctly with all pages and flows working. No hydration errors or console errors detected on any page.

All product data is hardcoded mock data
The @/ alias now resolves to root ./ instead of src/ - working correctly after migration

Test file updated to match new API response codes: product not found returns 404, order creation returns 201, status endpoint changed format.
